meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Haan — **Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye cream-based, barrier-repairing moisturizer** best rahega. Ceramides + hyaluronic acid/glycerin jaise ingredients useful hote hain, aur winter mein gel se richer cream generally better hoti hai. [etadviser.com](https://etadviser.com/beauty/body-care/best-winter-moisturisers-recommended-by-dermatologists-for-smooth-nourished-skin/articleshow/125545009.cms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### 🧴 Face ke liye

### [CeraVe Moisturising Cream]()
*₹422*

### [Re'equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser]()
*₹265*

### [Plum CeraSense Moisturizing Cream]()
*₹299*

### [The Derma Co Ceramide + HA Intense Daily Face Moisturizer]()
*₹314*

**Meri first choice:** **CeraVe Moisturising Cream** — especially agar skin *bahut dry, tight ya flaky* hoti hai. Ismein 3 ceramides + hyaluronic acid hain aur fragrance-free formulation hai. [etadviser.com](https://etadviser.com/beauty/body-care/best-winter-moisturisers-recommended-by-dermatologists-for-smooth-nourished-skin/articleshow/125545009.cms?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Budget-friendly:** Re'equil Ceramide & HA ya Plum CeraSense.

### Agar skin sensitive bhi hai
Fragrance-free moisturizer choose karo aur bahut hot water se face wash mat karo. Moisturizer **face wash ke turant baad slightly damp skin par** lagana helpful hota hai. [sunshineskinclinic.com](https://sunshineskinclinic.com/best-moisturizer-for-dry-skin-india/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Agar tum mujhe bata do **skin type (dry / oily / combination) + budget (₹300, ₹500, ₹1000)**, main tumhare liye **1 exact moisturizer** choose kar dunga.
